input: Volunteer at the animal shelter every other Saturday

gold.taskTitle: Volunteer at the Animal Shelter Bi-Weekly
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to establish a recurring volunteer commitment at an animal shelter every other Saturday.

questions.title: Which specific animal shelter do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the exact shelter the user wants to volunteer at, whether they already have one chosen or need to find one nearby.

questions.title: Have you already contacted the shelter about volunteering?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing relationship or application with the shelter, or is starting from scratch.

questions.title: What type of volunteer work do you want to do?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred role, such as dog walking, cat socializing, cleaning, adoption events, or administrative support.

questions.title: What time of day works best for you on Saturdays?
questions.description: Understand the user's preferred shift window, such as morning, afternoon, or a specific time range.

questions.title: Which Saturday do you want to start on?
questions.description: Pin down the target start date so the recurring schedule can be anchored correctly.

questions.title: Are there any Saturdays you already know you cannot make?
questions.description: Identify known conflicts, holidays, or travel plans that would interrupt the every-other-Saturday pattern.

questions.title: Do you need a reminder system to stay consistent?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants calendar alerts, weekly check-ins, or another accountability mechanism to maintain the habit.
